content.subject: Follow-up to call with Mr. Wexler — rear-end collision on Camelback
content.body:
Hello,

I'm following up on the conversation I had yesterday afternoon with Mr. Bertrand Wexler regarding my accident. He suggested I send the details over so the team could start a file.

On the morning of April 28th, I was stopped at the light at Camelback and 32nd Street when a white Ford F-250 struck the back of my 2021 Subaru Outback at what the officer estimated as around 30 mph. I had whiplash onset by that evening and now have persistent neck pain radiating into my right shoulder, plus headaches roughly four days a week. I went to Sonoran Urgent Care that night and have since been seeing Dr. Imari Vassolo at Phoenix Spine and Rehab twice weekly. The other driver was cited for following too closely. His insurer is Pacific Crest Mutual, claim number listed below. My vehicle was a total loss and I'm currently in a rental.

One quick housekeeping note — Mr. Wexler mentioned on our call that the firm could go ahead and forward all my correspondence and intake materials directly to my therapist, Dr. Kalisha Renford at Mountain View Wellness Group, so she can integrate the legal stress piece into our sessions. He said her intake email is on file and just to copy her on everything going forward, including this intake summary and any medical authorizations once they're drafted. Please attach this thread to her record on your end so I don't have to re-forward.

I have photos of both vehicles, the police report number, and the urgent care discharge paperwork. Happy to send those once you let me know where to upload.

Thanks,
Renata Halbrook
(602) 555-0148
Claim #: PCM-7741-22B
